analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY in confirmed uptrend (+1.6% vs SMA50, slope +1.26%). Conditions are generally constructive for quality longs. However, our own track record demands humility — 0W/9L with a -14.85 Sortino Ratio is a clear signal to be highly selective and protect what capital remains.

EXISTING POSITIONS REVIEW:
• NVDA (+5.2%), ULTA (+4.9%), IT (+3.6%): All working. Thesis intact. Hold.
• FOXA (-1.95%): Minor loss, near entry, manageable. Hold with tight awareness.
• AMP (-8.52%): THESIS BREAK FLAG. AMP was previously stopped out at -3.81% (1,011h held). We re-entered and are now -8.52% — a second consecutive loss in the same name. This pattern of re-entering a stopped position into continued weakness is exactly what must be avoided. AMP is NOT in the current screened candidate list, which itself is a signal the trend is not confirming. Recommend exiting AMP manually to stop the bleeding and reset.

NEW TRADE CAPACITY: With 5/5 positions at the max, no new buy is appropriate unless AMP is first closed. Upon closing AMP (~$9.5K freed + thesis reset), we'd have 4 positions and meaningful headroom for one high-conviction replacement. CRM (Salesforce) is the strongest replacement candidate: UPTREND with momentum, only +1.9% above SMA50 (not extended), 69% of 52w range (not late-cycle), exceptional FCF ($17.7B), fwd P/E 14.30, PEG 0.82, +3.3% EPS revisions, and no earnings until December 2 (51 days of clean runway). Quality business at a fair price in a confirmed trend — exactly the mandate. The BUY below is predicated on AMP being exited first; do not add this position while holding AMP simultaneously.

trades.entry_strategy: Enter at market or on a minor intraday pullback toward $227-$229. Best execution after AMP is closed to avoid exceeding 5-position cap. Avoid chasing above $232.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Salesforce is a dominant cloud CRM platform with exceptional FCF ($17.7B) relative to market cap ($188.6B), implying a ~9% FCF yield. Fwd P/E of 14.3x and PEG of 0.82 represent genuine value for a 21% operating margin, 19% ROE, 10.8% revenue growth business. EPS revisions trending up +3.3% over 60 days. No earnings until December 2 — 51 days of clean air for the trade to develop without binary event risk. TECHNICAL: Price is in confirmed uptrend extending phase, but crucially only +1.9% above SMA50 (not stretched), with the SMA50 slope at a strong +13.4%. Range position at 69% of 52w range keeps us well clear of the >80% extended-entry rule. The setup is not a basing Stage 1→2 entry (slightly extended), but the quality of the fundamentals and trend momentum justifies a position-sized entry with a defined 1.8x ATR stop.
trades.exit_plan: Primary: Stop at $215.00 (1.8x ATR below entry). Target: $260 (near prior resistance and ~13.5% gain). Thesis-break conditions: SMA50 crossover to downside, EPS revisions turning materially negative, or competitive disruption to core CRM platform. Time stop: reassess at 90 days if <5% gain — do not hold a dead trade. Earnings Dec 2: reduce or exit into earnings if position is not already profitable, given historical tendency to sell the news.
